revision.construction: Retain330 through nominal knee peak. At9subsequent swingknots solve14hardfoot/COM equalities with16unknowns and originaljointbounds; knee additionally bounded between old330knee and oldpeak. Objective .5*(knee-peak)^2 +.5e-6*sum((f,p-oldf)^2);1e-6 is fixed offline tie-break weight, not controllergain. Descent>=max(previous,old),orientation>=previous,both<=1. Wholeapproach maps landingprogress to1; finalapproach/load exact330. Oneconstruction, no weight orparameter sweep.
